notes:
## JustMic v1.1.0

- assembly version 1.1.0
- version 1.1.0
- release automation: GitHub Actions workflow publishes tagged versions to justmic-releases (installer + latest.json); build scripts take -Version
- LoadPreset applies input and output gain from the preset
- presets include input and output gain (every dial); only mute stays live
- link import: browser-like headers with a curl.exe fallback for sites that refuse .NET clients; cleaner myinstants titles
- presets are explicit snapshots (modified marker, reload on click, revert); import sounds from YouTube / myinstants / direct links
- code signing hooks: tools/sign.ps1 (Azure Artifact Signing), installer + uninstaller signed when a profile is configured
- tools/publish-release.ps1: build, release, latest.json and site data in one step
- JustMic: update-feed tooltip
- JustMic: official update feed by default (justmic-releases/latest.json), site links in the installer
- JustMic: trash icon with two-click confirm in the preset menu; deleted presets archived to %APPDATA%\JustMic\presets, built-ins only hidden; recover list in Settings > Profiles
- JustMic: click a knob's readout to type its value (range-checked, Enter/click away saves, Esc/Delete cancels)
- JustMic: INPUT SPECTRUM (mic icon) and OUTPUT SPECTRUM of the selected output device via loopback (headphones icon) in the MASTER module
- JustMic: separators between your presets, the standard ones and the voice-changer characters in the preset menu
- JustMic: larger default window (no scrolling), VOICE character layer on top of any preset, preset list ordered yours / standard / voice-changer
- JustMic: rack-styled menus (preset list, pads), rename preset from the preset menu
- JustMic: calibration steps can be redone / revisited (Back, Redo, Next; result only when every step is measured or skipped); preset LCD opens a preset menu
- JustMic: first-launch guided setup (mic, headphones + test tone, hear-yourself level, voice calibration, Windows defaults), re-runnable from Settings
- JustMic: settings navbar selects on click (items must be focusable), HEAR ME level knob + LED on the OUTPUT module
- JustMic: SAVE preset button in the top bar and 'Apply & save as preset' in the setup wizard
- JustMic: black text on lime buttons and selected dropdown items
- JustMic: knob arcs from the default position (lime above / amber below), centred logo glyph, pulsing red logo while muted
- JustMic: window buttons on the right side of the title bar
- JustMic v2: rack UI, more effects, Soundpad-style soundboard, low-latency monitor, integrations
- JustMic: settings that survive (backup + mirror + shutdown flush), no driver re-install, visible autostart, keyboard/mouse wizard phase
- JustMic: Inno Setup installer with driver/device setup, Task Manager-visible startup entry, single playback endpoint
- JustMic: live theme switch for all windows, adapter rename, monitor with/without effects, measured defaults
- ﻿JustMic: JustMe dark/light theme, settings + setup wizard, own virtual microphone install, review fixes
- JustMic: virtual microphone app with studio chain, guards and Discord/Steam AGC enforcement
